Q1.rationale: Base [20] bars disclosure of Confidential Information to any third party without written approval, which would cover government agencies; the only carve-outs are section 4 (auditors and service providers) and the FOIPPA and other applicable-law language in [33], with no exception for reports of possible violations.
Q1.label: Entailment

Q2.rationale: V2 only adds the Nova Scotia governing-law sentence; base [20] still bars disclosure to third parties without approval, with the same carve-outs in [33] and section 4 and no exception for reports of possible violations.
Q2.label: Entailment
